programme.title: House of Traps
programme.desc: A team of skilled fighters navigate a house rigged with an array of ingenious and deadly traps.

programme.title: The New Option
programme.desc: An elite cop fulfils his dream to join the Special Duty Unit. Now, he faces rigorous training and the challenge of stopping a daring heist by a gang of dangerous criminals.

programme.title: Guns & Roses
programme.desc: Jin Shui risks everything to save his family, fleeing France with the help of his friend. Amid challenges, Jin Shui faces a dilemma: love or loyalty to his friend.

programme.title: Ten Tigers Of Kwangtung
programme.desc: Anti-Ch'ing revolutionary leader, Chai Min Yu, is being hunted down by Manchu General Liang. He is almost caught when a masked man rescues him from death and escapes with him.

programme.title: The Brave Archer
programme.desc: Guo Jing falls in love with Huang, but Ouyang also wants to marry her. Huang's father sets a duel to decide her fate. Guo must defeat Ouyang to win Huang Rong back.

programme.title: Four Riders
programme.desc: A kung-fu master must take on a venal drug-smuggling gang. Representing the Book of Revelation's four riders, the heroes fight against murder, corruption, jealousy and greed.

programme.title: The 14 Amazons
programme.desc: The Yang family had served their country in Song Dynasty for generations. General Yang is ambushed and killed during the war in Jin Shan.

programme.title: The Last Blood
programme.desc: The Dalai Lama and Bee's girlfriend are injured by the Red Army. Bee must find the three donors with a rare blood type within 12 hours and fight against the terrorists to save them.

programme.title: A World Without Thieves
programme.desc: While con man Bo and femme fatale Li swindle their way across China, Li suddenly decides to leave Bo. However, their encounter with Fu Gen changes their fate forever.

programme.title: My Date With A Vampire
programme.desc: Heir to a demon-hunting clan, Ma Xiao Ling teams up with Kuang Tian You, a vampire posing as an immortal detective, to stop shadow attacks and resolve a century-old feud.

programme.title: Knockout
programme.desc: A retired boxer tries to help a new student who is being targeted by bullies.

programme.title: The Moon Warrior
programme.desc: A benevolent fisherman living a simple life is reluctantly drawn into helping a noble emperor regain his throne from his evil brother.

programme.title: Executioners From Shaolin
programme.desc: The White-Browed Priest supports the brutal Qing government, burning down Shaolin Temple and hunting its disciples.

programme.title: The Butcher's Blade
programme.desc: When disaster relief funds disappear, upstanding constable Xue Buyi is framed for the disappearance.

programme.title: One-Armed Swordsman
programme.desc: A noble swordsman, whose arm had been chopped off, returns to his former teacher to defend him from a villainous gang of rival swordsmen.

programme.title: Mr Vampire
programme.desc: When Master Ko is asked to monitor the relocation of a grave, he discovers that the corpse has become a vampire. He must now use his obscure skill to set matters right.

programme.title: Young Ip Man: Crisis Time
programme.desc: Young Ip Man pursues his studies in Hong Kong in 1917. When the whole school is held hostage during the day of an English speech competition, Ip Man decides to step up.

programme.title: 曼谷風雲
programme.desc: 地下拳手林楓因拒絕替曼谷黑幫打黑拳,因此被追殺。他雖成功逃脫,卻失去記憶。當林楓開展其新生活時,卻被黑幫發現行蹤,並找來絕頂打手對付他。期間林楓忽然回復記憶,並誓要將黑幫殲滅。

programme.title: 武松鬥殺西門慶
programme.desc: 豪傑武松因揭發嫂子潘金蓮與西門慶的奸情而遭陷害,被迫刺配流放。當得知兄長武大郎慘遭毒殺後,武松悲憤回鄉討回公道,卻發現官府貪贓枉法,拒絕嚴懲真兇。面對黑白顛倒的世道,怒火中燒的武松決意血戰獅子樓,親手..

programme.title: A Good Deal
programme.desc: 商人Burks被一對走投無路的夫婦綁架,被迫踏上開往洛杉磯的亡命之旅。途中危機四伏,三人發現彼此隱藏著致命的秘密。一場原本以為簡單的綁架,卻演變成奪命的博弈,當中沒有人能按計劃全身而退!

programme.title: 倒數回擊
